How do you like the dress I'm wearing? 55.你想…吗（Do you want to…） Do you want to meet me next Sunday? Do you want to come with me to the cinema? Do you want to walk with me? Do you want to grab a cup of coffee? Do you want to go out on a date with me? 56.你有…吗（Do you have…） Do you have a minute to talk? Do you have any questions? Do you have any siblings? Do you have a pen I can borrow? Do you have feelings for me? 57.是什么感觉（What is it like…） What is it like living in Japan? What is it like not having a smartphone? What is it like in India? What is it like to be in love? What is it like to have a pet? 58.你是怎么…的（How did you…） How did you do that? How did you get my number? How did you get here? How did you come up with that idea? How did you meet your best friend? 59.你准备好了吗（Are you ready…） Are you ready? Are you ready for this? Are you ready to order? Are you ready for bed? Are you ready for the test? Are you ready to go shopping? 60.为什么（How come…） How come you think so? How come you don't call me? How come I sweat so much? How come you're late again? How come you didn't tell me about the party? 61.你能…吗（Can you…） Can you tell me what I should do next? Can you show me your passport? Can you make it on time? Can you pass me the salt, please? Can you lend me a pen for a moment? 62. 你怎么看（What do you think of…） What do you think of that movie? What do you think of me? What do you think of my new haircut? What do you think of the latest episode of that TV show? What do you think of him as a potential partner? 63. 我应该…吗（Should I…） Should I stay? Should I go to the gym every day? Should I do it? Should I call and confirm our reservation? Should I apologize for what I said? 64. 你知道怎么…吗（Do you know how to…） Do you know how to get there? Do you know how to use them?
